purpose: Local host, port and service discovery
scope: Loopback host only, and only the ports listed in tools.nmap.ports (3001 by default).
severity_mapping: All findings are informational: port discovery is not vulnerability assessment.
notes: Produces INFO findings only. A closed or filtered port is recorded as a note, not a finding.

install.generic: Install Nmap from https://nmap.org/download.html, or run it through the Docker image instrumentisto/nmap.
